Verbatim validation: resolve placeholders per the request placeholder map, or match canonical text with tokens intact; any other deviation is a ClauseResolutionError.

clauses.name: First-draft rule
clauses.canonicalText: All output produced by [TOOL / CONNECTOR NAME] must be treated as a draft. Users remain responsible for verifying facts, recipients, attachments, names, dates, figures, commitments, and source material before use.

clauses.name: Approved access boundary
clauses.canonicalText: [TOOL / CONNECTOR NAME] may only be used by approved users and only through approved business accounts, approved connection methods, and approved client use cases.

clauses.name: Least-content rule
clauses.canonicalText: Users should provide the minimum amount of content necessary to complete the task and should remove unnecessary identifiers, account numbers, credentials, confidential details, or restricted data before use.

clauses.name: Prohibited credential handling
clauses.canonicalText: Users must not enter or expose passwords, secrets, API keys, MFA codes, recovery codes, tokens, or other credential material.

clauses.name: Sensitive data boundary
clauses.canonicalText: Restricted personal data, regulated data, financial account data, health data, legal data, client confidential data, and other highly sensitive content must not be processed outside the approved scope.

clauses.name: Audit validation limitation
clauses.canonicalText: Audit visibility, retention, and item-level evidence depend on Microsoft licensing, audit configuration, retention policy, workload, and the specific audit event. Tenant-specific validation is required before relying on item-level chain-of-custody.

clauses.name: Restricted Content Discovery caution
clauses.canonicalText: Restricted Content Discovery should be treated as a SharePoint discoverability control where applicable. Connector search behavior should be validated in the target tenant before assuming restricted content is excluded from connector results.

clauses.name: Risk acceptance trigger
clauses.canonicalText: Any deviation from the approved runbook, approved user scope, approved permission model, logging posture, training requirement, or sensitive-data boundary must be reviewed before implementation and documented with a Risk Acceptance and Sign-off Form when required.

clauses.name: Escalation trigger
clauses.canonicalText: Users must stop and escalate when data sensitivity, access scope, prompt suitability, output accuracy, audit evidence, or policy approval is unclear.

clauses.name: System of record limitation
clauses.canonicalText: [TOOL / CONNECTOR NAME] must not be used as a system of record, archive, official approval mechanism, evidence repository, or final source of truth.
